description: ReportForge subsystem ownership map — PR-1 of E2R. No scores. No snapshots. Conservative, verifiable inventory.

subsystems.name: document-state
subsystems.notes: Central SSOT for all mutable designer state. All mutations must pass through DocumentActions + RuntimeWriteLog. The property setters on DS (via defineProperty loop in DocumentStore.js) bypass write logging — callers must use set* methods, not direct assignment. P31C reclaimed (confirmed <script>-loaded in designer-v4.html + real consumer, was a RULE-ORPHAN gap, not a zombie): DocumentActionsSelection.js (required directly by DocumentActions.js — provides createSelectionActions, the clearSelectionState/replaceSelection/selectOnly/addSelection/removeSelection/toggleSelection implementations DocumentActions spreads in via `...sa`); DocumentStoreUtils.js (DocumentStore.js calls `global.DocumentStoreUtils.install(global, newId, mkEl)` at init — throws hard if absent, confirming it is a required, not optional, dependency).
unresolvedAmbiguities: DocumentHistory.js is composed inside DocumentStore.js but has distinct undo/redo responsibility — see SS-02 for boundary question

subsystems.name: render-scheduler
subsystems.notes: RenderSchedulerObservability.js is a pure observability layer — zero DOM, zero globals, zero rAF. All 7 functions (now, recordFrameTime, recordHotspot, getFrameRate, clearStorm, getHotspots, clearHotspots) take an S object as first argument and operate on it directly — fully testable without browser context. Storm detection guards dispatchEvent behind availability check. RenderScheduler.js, RenderSchedulerState.js, RenderSchedulerQueue.js, RenderSchedulerScope.js, RenderSchedulerFrame.js moved to SS-35 render-scheduler-runtime.

subsystems.name: geometry
subsystems.notes: GeometryCore.js is pure math — zero DOM, zero side effects, no globals. All 19 functions are deterministic transforms over plain objects. CanvasGeometry.js is sharedFiles (used by canvas-layout and geometry). Runtime init files (RuntimeConfig, RuntimeData, RuntimeHelpers, RuntimeGeometry, RuntimeGlobals) moved to SS-33 runtime-init.

subsystems.name: canvas-layout
subsystems.notes: CanvasLayoutEngine.js is a pure delegation facade (22 lines) — it routes calls to CanvasLayoutSize and CanvasLayoutElements without owning any logic. Risk reduced from critical to low: (1) delegation targets have functional vm tests (canvas_layout_element + canvas_layout_section), (2) canvas_layout_guard enforces the API surface and delegation pattern, (3) boundary split moved all implementation to SS-27 canvas-rendering, leaving SS-05 as a thin coordinator. CanvasLayoutContracts.js is sharedFiles (consumed by both Size and Elements). SectionEngine vs SectionLayoutEngine ambiguity resolved: SectionEngine = init phase (creates DOM from scratch on render), SectionLayoutEngine = update phase (adjusts heights/widths on zoom or resize). Delegation split ambiguity resolved by guard.

subsystems.name: selection-drag
subsystems.notes: ssot_guard.mjs enforces DragEngine→DragState delegation. SelectionInteraction.js is a thin orchestrator delegating to SelectionInteractionPointer.js (event initiation) and SelectionInteractionMotion.js (drag logic). All three are loaded in v4.html. P31C reclaimed (confirmed <script>-loaded in designer-v4.html + real consumer, was a RULE-ORPHAN gap, not a zombie): SelectionEnginePreviewBridge.js (consumed by SelectionEngine.js); SelectionOverlayPreview.js and SelectionOverlayRender.js (SelectionOverlay.js reads `globalThis.SelectionOverlayPreview`/`globalThis.SelectionOverlayRender` and throws hard if either is absent — required, not optional, dependencies). P31C also retired DragEngine.js's begin()/update()/commit() (and internal _updateMove/_updateResize/_snap helpers) — confirmed zero callers anywhere in the repo; cancel() remains, reachable via KeyboardEngine.js's Escape handler.
unresolvedAmbiguities: HandlesEngine.js vs SelectionOverlay.js: both appear to render selection handles. Canonical file not confirmed.
SelectionState.js vs DS.selection: SelectionState exposes its own API (selectOnly, addSelection, etc.) in parallel with DS.selectOnly etc. — are these the same object or two separate state stores?

subsystems.name: preview
subsystems.notes: justification: covered by runtime regression baseline runtime-preview.png and preview_clipping_user_parity.test.mjs. PreviewEngine.js is the top-level compositor (previously named PreviewEngineV19 in docs). PreviewZoomEngine lives inside ZoomEngine.js (SS-11) — cross-subsystem coupling. P31C reclaimed (confirmed <script>-loaded in designer-v4.html + real consumer, was a RULE-ORPHAN gap, not a zombie): PreviewEngineRendererLayout.js (PreviewEngineRenderer.js reads `global.PreviewEngineRendererLayout` directly for its layout helpers).
unresolvedAmbiguities: PreviewZoomEngine is defined inside ZoomEngine.js (SS-11) but exclusively used by PreviewEngineMode — boundary ownership unclear
DS._sampleData is read by PreviewEngineData but assigned by DocTypeAndProbes (SS-16) — cross-subsystem write to private state field

subsystems.name: commands
subsystems.notes: CommandRuntime.js is a 26-line pure wiring facade: Object.assign merges selection/view/sections into CommandEngine, assigns FileEngine, exposes 11 handler globals — no DOM access, no monkey-patches, no external engine calls, no conditional logic. Risk reduced from high to low: the high-risk behaviour (DOM manipulation, prompt/confirm calls, localStorage, DS.saveHistory monkey-patch) resides exclusively in the sub-modules now owned by SS-28/29/30/31/32. command_runtime_guard.mjs enforces the no-inline-function constraint to prevent logic creep. CommandRuntimeShared.js and CommandRuntimeInit.js moved to sharedFiles — consumed by multiple sub-modules.

subsystems.name: command-selection
subsystems.notes: justification: command_runtime_selection.test.mjs covers all 20 operations via vm isolation (align math, z-order, clipboard offset, group/invert). Element selection and manipulation commands mutate DS.elements/selection and delegate DOM updates to _canonicalCanvasWriter(). No direct DOM construction — only position/z-order updates via the canvas writer.

subsystems.name: command-sections
subsystems.notes: justification: governance_guardrails.test.mjs structural tests confirm no inline wiring in the monolith. Section management and object visibility commands. Calls prompt() for renameSection (blocking UI). lockObject/unlockObject/hideObject/showObject are object-level commands co-located here for historical reasons — they manipulate DS.elements directly. Risk high: direct DS mutation, prompt() calls, and renderAll() invocations on every operation.

subsystems.name: command-io
subsystems.notes: File I/O (localStorage, FileReader, Blob URL) and document-type switching. CommandRuntimeDocType.js mutates FieldExplorerEngine._activeTree directly and calls confirm() when switching doc type. Risk high: browser APIs (localStorage, URL.createObjectURL, FileReader), blocking dialogs (prompt, confirm), and cross-engine mutation (FieldExplorerEngine). P31C reclaimed (confirmed <script>-loaded in designer-v4.html + real consumer, was a RULE-ORPHAN gap, not a zombie): CommandRuntimeFileIO.js (CommandRuntimeFile.js's save/load/exportJSON/exportPDF/importJSON getters all delegate directly to `global.CommandRuntimeFileIO.*` — unguarded, required dependency).

subsystems.name: command-dispatcher
subsystems.notes: justification: governance_guardrails.test.mjs + content_edit_smoke_user_parity.test.mjs verify end-to-end dispatch. UI event dispatcher layer — 120-case switch in handleAction routes application-level events to engines (ZoomEngine, InsertEngine, FormatEngine, GridEngine, RulerEngine, AlignmentGuides, PreviewEngineRenderer). This is not a command but a UI adapter hub. Risk high: calls confirm() for new/quit, uses prompt() for margin commands, and dispatches to 8+ external engines. It is the application's single input surface. P31C reclaimed (confirmed <script>-loaded in designer-v4.html + real consumer, was a RULE-ORPHAN gap, not a zombie): all 9 are destructured directly and unguarded at the top of CommandRuntimeHandlers.js — CommandRuntimeHandlersFile.js (handleFileCommands), CommandRuntimeHandlersPreview.js (handlePreviewCommands), CommandRuntimeHandlersZoom.js (handleZoomCommands), CommandRuntimeHandlersSelectionDispatch.js (handleSelectionCommands), CommandRuntimeHandlersFormat.js (handleFormatCommands), CommandRuntimeHandlersInsert.js (handleInsertCommands), CommandRuntimeHandlersLayout.js (handleLayoutCommands), CommandRuntimeHandlersDialog.js (handleDialogCommands), CommandRuntimeHandlersSystem.js (handleSystemCommands) — these ARE the 120-case switch's real implementation, split one-file-per-command-category.

subsystems.name: command-view
subsystems.notes: View-level commands: zoomFitPage/Width compute scale from workspace dimensions and delegate to DesignZoomEngine.setFree(). addHGuide/addVGuide/removeGuide create/remove DOM guide elements in guide-layer. Risk medium: DOM construction but no state mutation beyond guide-layer appendChild/remove.

subsystems.name: insert
subsystems.notes: Single file, 83 lines. Could be absorbed into SS-08 commands. Kept separate because it owns the DS.tool write and the insert-drag gesture lifecycle.

subsystems.name: format-properties
subsystems.notes: FormatEngine may mutate element properties (color, fontFamily, etc.) directly on the element object rather than through DS.setElements — needs verification. If confirmed, this is a write-log bypass.
unresolvedAmbiguities: FormatEngine.applyFormat: does it mutate element.* directly or go through DocumentActions? Not confirmed from code scan.

subsystems.name: zoom
subsystems.notes: Single file containing three objects: DesignZoomEngine, PreviewZoomEngine, ZoomWidget. Low cohesion. PreviewZoomEngine is used exclusively by SS-07 preview but lives here. DS.previewZoom is written directly (non-critical field, no setPreviewZoom method in DocumentActions).
unresolvedAmbiguities: PreviewZoomEngine ownership: logically belongs to preview (SS-07) but physically lives in ZoomEngine.js

subsystems.name: snap
subsystems.notes: CORRECTED P31B: the previous note claiming 'SnapCore.js and SnapState.js are the active implementation' was false — neither file was ever loaded by any designer/*.html <script> tag (confirmed P30A/P31A), so every typeof-guarded call into them was always a no-op. The real, only snapping implementation has always been engines/DocumentSelectors.js's own DS.snap(value) (Math.round(value/grid)*grid using CFG.MODEL_GRID/state.snapToGrid), which is what CommandRuntimeSelection.js, InsertEngine.js, SelectionState.js, FieldExplorerEngine.js, and DragEngine.js (post-P31B) all call. SnapCore.js/SnapState.js were retired in P31B (deleted, zero functional role). Ctrl+; previously called the also-dead SnapState.toggle() (permanent no-op); now delegates to the same handleAction('toggle-snap') path the menu item already used, so it actually toggles DS.snapToGrid in sync with the #btn-snap UI state.

subsystems.name: guide-rendering
subsystems.notes: GuideEngine.js and GuideRenderer.js duplicate _getContainer(), GUIDE_COLOR constants and rendering logic. AlignmentGuides.js and AlignmentGuideOverlay.js also duplicate guide DOM creation. UI-only — no DS critical field mutations.

subsystems.name: clipboard
subsystems.notes: ssot_guard.mjs enforces ClipboardEngine→ClipboardState delegation. DS.clipboard is still written directly by CommandRuntimeSelection (non-critical field, runtime_trace_guard warns but does not fail). Dual write path: ClipboardState.set() and DS.clipboard=.
unresolvedAmbiguities: DS.clipboard vs ClipboardState: two sources of truth for clipboard contents. DS.clipboard is the field read by consumers (DS.clipboard.length), ClipboardState is the SSOT. Are they kept in sync?

subsystems.name: keyboard
subsystems.notes: RETIRED P31B: KeyboardRegistry.js and KeyboardCombo.js deleted — both were zombies (never loaded by any designer/*.html <script> tag, confirmed P30A/P31A). KeyboardEngine.js's inline handler registry (previously a fallback for when KeyboardRegistry wasn't loaded) was always the real, only implementation in production with confirmed identical API/behavior; it is no longer a fallback for an absent delegate, it is simply the implementation. audit/subsystem_ssot_guard.mjs's KeyboardRegistry-specific rules (former RULE-C, part of RULE-D/E) were removed in the same change.

subsystems.name: formula-js
subsystems.notes: Frontend-only formula evaluator used by PreviewEngineData for field preview. Likely a subset of the Python formula evaluator (SS-B01). FormulaAndDebug.js may mix formula and debug concerns — low cohesion signal.
unresolvedAmbiguities: FormulaEngine.js (JS) vs Python formula evaluator: are they the same algorithm? Divergence would cause design-preview inconsistency.
FormulaAndDebug.js: mixing two concerns in one file — unclear if intentional or migration artifact

subsystems.name: doc-types-fields
subsystems.notes: FieldExplorerEngine.js owns field insertion (insertField/setupCanvasDrop) — confirmed it uses DS.setElements([...DS.elements, el], '...') correctly, not a direct DS.elements.push() bypass. FieldExplorerDrop.js was a byte-for-byte duplicate of that same logic, with zero production callers — retired in P17B.

subsystems.name: workspace-ui
subsystems.notes: RulerEngine reads ruler dimensions from RuntimeConfig (CFG.RULER_H, CFG.RULER_W) — enforced by configurational_ssot_guard. GridEngine.setVisible writes DS.gridVisible through DocumentActions.setGridVisible (with fallback for legacy environments). OverlayEngine manages multiple overlay layers.
unresolvedAmbiguities: OverlayEngine.js: manages which overlay layers exactly? Debug, guides, selection, all of them?

subsystems.name: engine-core-init
subsystems.notes: EngineCore.js is the single facade: wires createEngineCoreContracts (assertRectShape/assertSelectionState/assertLayoutContract/assertZoomContract), createEngineCoreRuntime (safe-mode, lifecycle), and createEngineCoreRouting (pointer/zoom/workspace dispatch). EngineCoreContracts.js and EngineCoreRuntime.js moved to sharedFiles — pure factories testable independently. EngineCoreRouting*.js extracted to SS-26. CI gate: engine_core_contracts_guard.mjs. P31C reclaimed (confirmed <script>-loaded in designer-v4.html + real consumer, was a RULE-ORPHAN gap, not a zombie): EngineCoreContractAsserts.js, EngineCoreContractSnapshots.js, EngineCoreContractValidators.js — all three loaded by engines/EngineCoreContracts.js's loadContractFactory(globalName, requirePath, exportName) dynamic factory lookup (e.g. 'EngineCoreContractAssertsFactory' / './EngineCoreContractAsserts.js' / 'createEngineCoreContractAsserts'), which is why a plain identifier grep missed them.

subsystems.name: debug
subsystems.notes: Non-production subsystem. Toggle channels: runtime, scheduler, invariants, elements, selection, resize, edit, overlay, zoom, scroll, move. Stored in localStorage so debug state survives page reload. P31C reclaimed (confirmed <script>-loaded in designer-v4.html, was a RULE-ORPHAN gap, not a zombie): BuildDebugPanel.js (self-installing — sets window.RF_BUILD_INFO and window.RF_REFRESH_BUILD_DEBUG at load, no external caller needed by design); DebugHudLayout.js, DebugPanelGeometry.js (debug HUD layout/geometry helpers); RFAudit.js (self-registering audit/diagnostics script). None has a traditional external caller — confirmed intentional for this self-installing-utility pattern, not evidence of dead code.

subsystems.name: ui-adapters
subsystems.notes: Thin adapter layer between DOM events and CommandEngine. DesignerUI.js switches between classic (Crystal Reports style) and modern UI modes. governance_guardrails.test.mjs test 7 enforces that the monolith does not define UI adapter wiring inline.
unresolvedAmbiguities: GlobalEventHandlers.js: what global events exactly? window.onresize, window.onkeydown, or something else?

subsystems.name: write-log
subsystems.notes: ENFORCED EXCEPTION (P31B, decided test-only — see audit/orphan_test_target_guard.mjs ENFORCED_EXCEPTIONS): confirmed RuntimeWriteLog.js is never loaded by any designer/*.html <script> tag, so engines/DocumentActions.js's `wl = typeof RuntimeWriteLog !== 'undefined' ? RuntimeWriteLog : null` guard is always false in production — recordWrite() never executes outside tests, where it is injected via globalThis/dynamic import. Decision: this governance log stays test-only by design rather than being loaded in production, because activating it now would be the first-ever production exercise of every DS-mutation write path with no observed governance failure motivating the risk. If that decision changes, this file must move from designer-runtime's never-loaded set to a real <script src="/engines/RuntimeWriteLog.js"> in designer-v4.html, and ssot_runtime_binding_guard.mjs will then require it. Append-only audit log for all DS mutations when active in tests. Throws hard on missing source or UNKNOWN source. Phase guard (off/warn/throw) enforces render-phase ordering. CI gate: audit/runtime_trace_guard.mjs scans engines/ for direct DS.<criticalField>= assignments that bypass this log (this static scan is unaffected by whether the file loads in the browser).

subsystems.name: formula-eval-python
subsystems.notes: Python formula tokenizer→parser→AST→evaluator with Crystal Reports function registry. Located at reportforge/core/render/expressions/. allowedFiles intentionally empty — Python modules not verified by this JS guard. File verification deferred to a dedicated Python guard.
unresolvedAmbiguities: Formula engine (JS, SS-15) vs formula evaluator (Python, SS-B01): algorithm parity not verified

subsystems.name: datasource
subsystems.notes: justification: no JS-accessible CI guard; Python integration tested via test_e2e_api_journey.py. Located at reportforge/core/render/datasource/. DB introspection, caching, multi-dataset coordination, live data feeds. allowedFiles intentionally empty — Python file verification deferred.

subsystems.name: element-rendering
subsystems.notes: justification: golden baseline tests cover rendering correctness. Located at reportforge/core/render/engines/. Renders HTML, barcodes, charts, crosstabs, tables, subreports. allowedFiles intentionally empty — Python file verification deferred.

subsystems.name: export-pipeline
subsystems.notes: justification: test_pdf_generator.py and test_round_trip.py cover export correctness. Located at reportforge/core/render/export/. Formats: CSV, DOCX, HTML, PDF, PNG, RTF, XLSX. allowedFiles intentionally empty — Python file verification deferred.

subsystems.name: doc-models-python
subsystems.notes: 5 document type models (factura, remision, nota_credito, retencion, liquidacion). Located at reportforge/core/models/. SSOT for document structure on the Python side. allowedFiles intentionally empty — Python file verification deferred.

subsystems.name: server-api
subsystems.notes: justification: test_server.py covers route correctness. Flask API located at reportforge/server/. Routes: datasources, designer, render, system, templates, tenants. Thin facade — all domain logic delegated to SS-B01 through SS-B04. allowedFiles intentionally empty — Python file verification deferred.

subsystems.name: engine-core-bootstrap
subsystems.notes: Two-phase boot: RuntimeBootstrap.js registers DOMContentLoaded listeners for Phase 1 init (DesignerUI, SnapState, GridEngine, WorkspaceScrollEngine, ZoomEngine). DeferredBootstrap.js registers separate DOMContentLoaded listeners for Phase 3 (CanvasLayoutEngine, HistoryEngine, ZoomApply patch, DS.saveHistory patch). Both run independently — order is determined by <script> tag position in HTML, not by internal synchronization. RuntimeServices.js/State/Trace are in sharedFiles (used here and by SS-18 routing layer).

subsystems.name: engine-core-routing
subsystems.notes: Five-file routing layer: EngineCoreRouting.js is the orchestrator (wires Pointer/Zoom/Registry/Workspace factories). EngineCoreRoutingPointer.js dispatches pointer events to SelectionEngine/DragEngine. EngineCoreRoutingZoom.js handles zoom-change events. EngineCoreRoutingRegistry.js registers all global engine instances. EngineCoreRoutingWorkspace.js wires DOM workspace events. All use dependency-injection factories (createEngineCoreRouting*(deps)) — testable without DOM. P31C reclaimed (confirmed <script>-loaded in designer-v4.html + real consumer, was a RULE-ORPHAN gap, not a zombie): EngineCoreRoutingPointerHelpers.js (EngineCoreRoutingPointer.js looks it up via `createEngineCoreRoutingPointerHelpers` — typeof guard then globalThis/window/require fallback chain).

subsystems.name: canvas-rendering
subsystems.notes: Implementation engines split from SS-05 canvas-layout facade. Responsibility boundary: SectionEngine = init phase (creates section DOM nodes from scratch via render()); SectionLayoutEngine = update phase (adjusts section heights/widths on zoom or resize). CanvasLayoutSize handles canvas-layer size computation (width/height/minHeight). CanvasLayoutElements handles element DOM rendering (buildElementDiv, renderAll, updateElement). ElementLayoutEngine applies model→view coordinate transforms to individual element divs. Risk medium: all engines interact with DOM but functional contracts are covered by canvas_layout_element and canvas_layout_section tests.

subsystems.name: runtime-init
subsystems.notes: Bootstrap-phase installers for global runtime state. RuntimeConfig.js is the SSOT for layout constants. RuntimeData.js installs CFG/FIELD_TREE/SAMPLE_DATA. RuntimeHelpers.js installs resolveField/formatValue/initClock. RuntimeGeometry.js installs RF.Geometry (DOM-dependent transforms). RuntimeGlobals.js mutates window.RF.Geometry directly at top level and also installs Matrix2D/AABB/MagneticSnap/PointerNorm — these classes ARE actively used (RF.Geometry.Matrix2D = Matrix2D confirmed). Split from SS-04 geometry (PR-3) to isolate DOM-dependent init from pure-math core.

coverageExclusion.justification: RuntimeGlobals.js and RuntimeGeometry.js use top-level global mutations and DOM-dependent install() patterns that require significant browser-context vm setup. Unit tests planned for sprint +2.

subsystems.name: history-runtime
subsystems.notes: justification: DOM-heavy runtime undo/redo engines split from SS-02. DocumentHistory.js: snapshot-based history wired into DocumentStore (canonical path via DS.saveHistory()); DOM access in updateUndoRedo() (btn-undo/btn-redo); orchestrates SectionEngine, CanvasLayoutEngine, PreviewEngineV19, SelectionEngine, PropertiesEngine, FormatEngine on undo/redo. HistoryEngine.js: singleton label-tracking stack used by CommandRuntime; _restore() invokes CanvasLayoutEngine + SectionLayoutEngine + OverlayEngine. HistorySnapshot.js: DS capture/apply utility (duplicates HistoryEngine._snapshot/_restore logic — backlog). HistoryEngine inline state duplicates HistoryState.js factory — backlog for next refactor.

coverageExclusion.justification: DocumentHistory.js and HistoryEngine.js require DOM + full runtime context (DS, CanvasLayoutEngine, SectionEngine, etc.) to unit test meaningfully. Covered end-to-end by undo_redo_user_parity tests.

subsystems.name: render-scheduler-runtime
subsystems.notes: justification: DOM-heavy scheduling runtime split from SS-03. RenderScheduler.js: top-level singleton S, uses requestAnimationFrame directly, orchestrates queue flush with phase order (layout→visual→handles→post). RenderSchedulerFrame.js: the ONLY writer of S.locked (enforced by governance_guardrails.test.mjs test 44). RenderSchedulerScope.js: currentWriteScope() singleton. These files require browser context (rAF, DOM callbacks) for meaningful unit testing.

coverageExclusion.justification: RenderScheduler.js and RenderSchedulerFrame.js depend on requestAnimationFrame and real DOM callback timing. Unit testing requires substantial browser-context mocking. Covered integration-level by governance_guardrails.test.mjs (phase enforcement, S.locked guard).

subsystems.name: alignment-runtime
subsystems.notes: justification: DOM-heavy alignment runtime, formerly split from SS-23 (retired in P17E — AlignmentGeometry.js was a byte-for-byte duplicate of AlignmentEngine.js's compute/computeSpacing/THRESHOLD with zero production callers; coverage migrated to load AlignmentEngine.js directly, alignment_geometry_guard.mjs retargeted to it). AlignEngine.js: facade calling CommandEngine.alignLeft/Right/Top/Bottom + DS.saveHistory() + _canonicalCanvasWriter().renderAll() in fallback. AlignmentEngine.js: live compute()/computeSpacing() (consumed by engines/DragEngine.js) + align()/distribute() with hard DS.getSectionTop calls. _bounds is closure-private to AlignmentEngine.js, intentionally not exported (P17E decision — no production need, pure arithmetic, no behavioral risk).

coverageExclusion.justification: AlignEngine.js requires DS, CommandEngine, and _canonicalCanvasWriter() to unit test meaningfully — covered integration-level by governance_guardrails.test.mjs. AlignmentEngine.js's compute()/computeSpacing()/THRESHOLD are unit-tested directly (no DOM/CommandEngine needed) by reportforge/tests/alignment_geometry.test.mjs since P17D; align()/distribute() remain untested (require DS.getSectionTop + element mutation context) — backlog.
